methods.label: Determine signs and multiply magnitudes
methods.explanation: The product of 2 numbers with the same sign is positive; multiply their absolute values: \((-3)\times(-4)=12\). The product of numbers with opposite signs is negative: \((-5)\times2=-10\).
methods.levelReason: The rational-number multiplication sign rule is Grade 7 content, supported by absolute values and elementary multiplication facts.
